lessons: The implementation passed all checks and review approved it with no findings. Merge failed only on the dirty_checkout gate: the main checkout has uncommitted edits to chupa/observe.py, tests/test_watch.py, vscode-chupa/extension.js and vscode-chupa/package.json, and the squash would overwrite them.

A human must inspect those four files in the main checkout. Then either commit the edits (if they are wanted) or revert them. Only then can the ticket re-run through the normal retry path, as the gate's paved_road says.
Do not change the implementation on the next attempt. The approved diff (8 files, 326 insertions) meets the ticket. A retry before the main checkout is clean will fail the same merge gate again.

If the operator commits the main-checkout edits to those fenced files, the next attempt must rebase onto them. Read the new chupa/observe.py, extension.js, package.json and test_watch.py before writing, so the box view does not overwrite those changes.
